envelope.description: Add session progress snapshots and targeted webview frames

body.title: Add session progress snapshots and targeted webview frames
body.summary: Add optional turn progress to stored session heads with ownership-aware merges. Define restore, update and action payloads carrying session, turn and view generation. Keep protocol and both ends compatible at each step.
acceptanceChecks: Restore carries current progress with the transcript and uses the original start timestamp. A legacy live turn without a known start omits elapsed time.
Old generation, session or turn updates cannot clear the selected view. Status changes do not become transcript rows.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/session-file-store.test.ts: session progress persists and a stale checkpoint cannot overwrite a newer turn
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/protocol.test.ts: restore and targeted action frames preserve session, turn and generation identity
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-shell.test.ts: session restore uses stored phase and elapsed time without another provider event
